title: Democrats approve 2028 primary calendar that puts South Carolina first
description: South Carolina would hold its primary on Jan. 22, 2028 under the Democratic National Committee’s plan. Nevada would follow on Feb. 1. The plan aims to give a bigger voice to Black and Latino voters.

title: State Department spokesperson on Iran war and U.S. visa revocations
description: NPR's Rob Schmitz speaks with State Department spokesperson Tommy Pigott about the with Iran and the hundreds of thousands of foreign nationals who have had their U.S. visa revoked.

title: Families of USS Lincoln crew say Trump should be 'ashamed' of conditions on board
description: President Trump said the USS Abraham Lincoln deployment is "not nearly long enough." A family member of a sailor on board that ship said those comments are shameful.

title: Navy weighs major warship redesign to match Trump’s preferences
description: The president wants the new fleet of aircraft carriers to more resemble those from World War II. Such a change could cost billions.

title: Democrats abandon Senate races in deep-red states, boosting independents
description: Democratic Senate nominees in Nebraska, Idaho and South Dakota dropped out, clearing the way for independents. But Alani Bankhead in Montana declined to join them.

title: Killings and other violent crimes dropped sharply in 2025
description: The White House is seizing on new statistics showing that violent crime plummeted last year to boast of a “Trump effect.” But experts note crime began falling well before Trump returned to office.

title: Week in Politics: USS Lincoln; latest primaries and Democrats; White House ballroom
description: A shortage of some munitions as well as the problems with the USS Lincoln have the Trump administration on the defensive. Meanwhile, what the latest primaries show about Democratic enthusiasm.

title: They fought for the U.S. in Afghanistan. Now they worry about losing their green cards
description: When the U.S. withdrew from Afghanistan five years ago, thousands of Afghans who helped U.S. troops were brought here to rebuild their lives. But now, some fear the U.S. may want to send them back.

title: Trump stumps in N.Y. suburbs, highlighting a dilemma for his party
description: The president can help rally his core supporters but remains deeply unpopular in many swing areas.

title: DeSantis says he doesn’t support Republican Rep. Cory Mills in Tuesday’s primary
description: The congressman is running for a third term under a cloud of controversy.

title: Trump wants to put golden seals on White House ballroom
description: The planned adornments, which were included in renderings submitted to the Supreme Court, break with tradition and the original vision for the White House grounds.

title: Trump dismisses families’ concerns about USS Abraham Lincoln conditions
description: President Donald Trump dismissed the concerns of military families about worsening conditions on the USS Abraham Lincoln.

title: Democrats grapple with Trump's push to limit transparency within the executive branch
description: President Trump is pushing the boundaries of executive power to limit transparency within the executive branch. Congressional Democrats are grappling with how to respond.

title: Trump officials ask Supreme Court to let ballroom construction continue
description: The request escalates the legal fight over the controversial project to the nation’s highest court.

title: Michigan’s marquee Senate race close in first poll after El-Sayed primary win
description: Both major-party candidates are unpopular in a race viewed as critical for Senate control.

title: Amid intra-MAGA fight, Trump weighs going all in for Darline Graham
description: The president is actively fighting for his endorsed candidate in the South Carolina Senate runoff, Sen. Darline Graham, the sister of the late Lindsey Graham.

title: Truth Social’s sale of fast access to Trump posts draws legal concerns
description: A lawsuit filed this week alleges that the product is unconstitutional, and other experts warn it could violate securities laws.

title: Alex Vindman knows he needs to ‘prove it’ in Florida
description: Alex Vindman thinks he can do what no Democrat has been able to do over the past decade: break through Republicans’ hold on Florida.

title: Sizing up the 2028 Republican presidential contenders
description: Can anyone win by distancing themselves from President Donald Trump?

title: U.S. missionary who was kidnapped in Niger is released
description: Kevin Rideout "is in good health in the care of US officials," SIM International said in a statement, adding he would soon be reunited with his family.

title: New aircraft carrier heads toward Mideast after reports of issues on long-deployed USS Lincoln
description: The Pacific-based aircraft carrier USS George Washington has begun heading toward the Middle East as reports have emerged of mental health and supply issues aboard the long-deployed USS Abraham Lincoln.

title: Judge drops Nevada case against electors accused of forging certificate in 2020 election
description: The dismissal marks the latest setback in swing states' efforts to prosecute fake electors who tried to keep Trump in the White House after he lost to Joe Biden in 2020.

title: AIPAC didn't always spend on campaigns. Now it faces criticism over money in politics
description: U.S. support for Israel has been a central issue in Democratic primary contests. That's put a spotlight on the pro-Israel lobbying group AIPAC and the strength of its political influence.

title: Democratic socialism's next test is the Midwest
description: A democratic socialist narrowly lost Wisconsin's Democratic gubernatorial primary. But conversations with swing voters suggest voters may be more open to the "socialist" label than expected.
